messages:
Maria: kicking off deployment window for runtime v2.3.1-rc3 to canary (region: us-west-2). rolling 10% -> 50% over 15m. Monitoring checks enabled.
Kevin: noted. I'll run the smoke SLO queries and watch p50/p95 across tokens. If p95 > 350ms for 3m, we'll pause.
DeployBot: [deploy started] canary group: canary-01 target: 10% image: rwd-infer:v2.3.1-rc3
Jamie: seeing ~1.2% 5xx spike in embed-service downstream, dashboard link <https://console.redwood/slo?svc=embed-service&range=5m> :eyes:  
Maria: @Jamie paste the query you ran
Jamie: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="embed-service",code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (code)` results: 0.012 -> baseline 0.002
Lia: adding quick mitigation: pin route -> model v2.3.0-hotfix for traffic to embed-service for 5m
Kevin: propose rollback to v2.3.0-hotfix for canary if 5xx > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes OR p95 increase > 2x
Maria: agree. Also enable circuit-breaker fallback: `fallback_policy: model_variant: stable-quant` in runtime config
Jamie: running trace samples, looks like memory pressure on embed pods during new tensor cast path
OncallBot: Alert: embed-service 5xx rate > alert-threshold (3m) 
Maria: decision: pause rollout at 10%, pin canary to v2.3.0-hotfix for 30m, create Jira INF-4823 for root cause
Kevin: will flip routing and update release notes. @DeployBot please revert traffic to pinned version
DeployBot: [deploy update] traffic rebalanced -> canary pinned to rwd-infer:v2.3.0-hotfix
Maria: posting change note in #release-notes: 'Canary paused due to embed-service 5xx increase; rolled back canary variant. Investigating tensor cast path.'
Jamie: adding logs snippet: ```stderr: oom-killer triggered on pod embed-xyz: killed process 1234 (infer) due to memory```
Lia: scheduling follow-up postmortem and a focused perf test against the cast path. Thanks all :heart:
Kevin: will run a controlled perf run on staging and share numbers in ~45m
Maria: closing thread; monitor for additional alerts. :eyes:
